facebook.caption:
This place fixes the noise in your head.

Dinh Cậu Lighthouse sits right at the tip of the rock, where the sea hits three ways at once. Locals come here to sit. Not to take photos. Just to sit.

Sunset here runs different from the beach clubs. No DJ. No cocktail menu. Just the light changing and the boats moving.

Add this to your last evening in Phu Quoc. You'll thank yourself.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walk to the end of the rock. Watch the lighthouse catch the last light. This is Dinh Cậu at golden hour and it costs nothing to get here.
